entities.name: K4B6C9
observations: Exact sequence match to the supplied 351-aa sequence; UniProt reference is tomato (Solanum lycopersicum) EXPRESSION OF TERPENOIDS 1.

Curated function: nuclear transcription activator involved in terpene biosynthesis in glandular trichomes; binds the linalool synthase TPS5 promoter and synergizes with MYC1 to promote TPS5 transactivation.
Sequence analysis reports Pfam DUF702 (PF05142) at residues 126–273.
Sequence-derived estimates: 38.5 kDa; pI 7.37; GRAVY −0.827. N/C-terminal composition includes histidine-, glutamine-, asparagine-, glycine-, serine- and proline-rich low-complexity stretches.
